Our chance to flip the House Biden-Blue
| Team, amid the total MAGA mess in Congress, House Democrats are unified and hard at work fighting for the American people. **_They’re HEROES!_**

We’re reaching out to 200 TOP Democrats across the country with the exclusive opportunity to thank House Democrats for their amazing work! **Hurry, your signature spot isn’t open long:[**Sign the thank you card now!**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54848?t=6&akid=11190%2E878179%2EjnvnSG)** | [Donate $3 to sign the letter now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54848?t=7&akid=11190%2E878179%2EjnvnSG)
---
TO: House Democratic Caucus
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you. **Dear House Democrats,

_Thank you for your incredible work for the American people!_**

The far-right Republican majority is a total DISASTER, even ousting their own Speaker just last week.

Meanwhile, your caucus under Rep. Hakeem Jeffries’s leadership is unified and dedicated to saving abortion rights, voting rights, our democracy, and more.

Your strength makes me proud to be a Democrat — **and gives me hope that we can take down the GOP’s razor-thin majority next November!**

[**Fighting against the MAGA dark money machine won’t be easy, so I’m chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to show my appreciation and to help flip the 5 seats we need to turn the House BIDEN-BLUE! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54848?t=8&akid=11190%2E878179%2EjnvnSG) | [Donate $3 to sign now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/54848?t=9&akid=11190%2E878179%2EjnvnSG)

| | Paid for by VPP
(www.protectvoting.org)
Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 401 2nd Ave. S, Ste. 303, Seattle, WA 98104

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=11190%2E878179%2EjnvnSG). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=11190%2E878179%2EjnvnSG).**

name: Christine Drazan
subject: ICYMI: Oregon’s housing crisis requires A New Direction
body:
[](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-r/)
### Friend,
### **There is an affordability crisis in Bend. That 's why** [_**this past week I sat down with local officials, home builders, and advocates in Bend for A New Direction's first roundtable on housing and affordability.**_](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-y/) My organization, A New Direction, is focused on bringing people together to advocate for solutions to Oregon's most pressing issues. We heard from a range of community members who are deeply invested in Central Oregon and willing to continue the important conversations that lead to progress on the housing crisis.
### **Local leaders are already working diligently on innovative solutions but they made it clear that state and local reforms are needed to make Central Oregon affordable for everyone. **
### Right now, the need for more housing is at a crossroads with regulations. Our complex land use system impacts **local leader 's ability to meet the needs of the community.**
**Even non-profit builders are facing too many hurdles.** Cory Bittner, Vice President of Pahlisch Homes, said he's working with some of these people, and the process they have to go through is "mindblowing." **Addressing the housing affordability crisis requires us to listen to those on the ground who are actively engaged in the work.** Shockingly, Bittner said that a month delay in government permitting can add up to a half million dollars in the cost of developing a neighborhood. Friend, it's clear we need a comprehensive approach to create an Oregon where working people can afford to live, and Central Oregon's local leaders are eager to partner with the state to achieve this.Thank you for your ongoing support, and please stay tuned for further updates on our efforts to advance policies and ideas that make Oregon a safer, more affordable place to live and raise a family, strengthen checks and balances, empower Oregonians and support the next generation. Christine Drazan [](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-j/)[](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-t/)[](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-i/)[](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-d/) | [Preferences](https://andor.updatemyprofile.com/y-xlddthl-172B6299-dihkkhuuli-h) | [Unsubscribe](https://andor.cmail19.com/t/y-u-xlddthl-dihkkhuuli-o/)
---

| | Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century’s most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings—an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.

[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjg2LWQzOGQ3ZDU2M2Y5NjQ4MjhiMWFhYmViM2QyNWI2NzJkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2xwLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvdGhlLWlua2xpbmdzLWNjYS8_c2M9MDAyOTdOMDI0MkwwNkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWlua2xpbmdzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWltYWdlX0FFX0ZBTFI0MzU2NCJ9/ngomKnMkxUVyzh1LXz8zrg)
**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings by using this secure link now:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjg2LWQzOGQ3ZDU2M2Y5NjQ4MjhiMWFhYmViM2QyNWI2NzJkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjIiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2xwLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvdGhlLWlua2xpbmdzLWNjYS8_c2M9MDAyOTdOMDI0MkwwNkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWlua2xpbmdzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWltYWdlX0FFX0ZBTFI0MzU2NCJ9/3nkWcobLLTFKUGgnqGLGYw)**

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books—such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ —and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien’s most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we’ve created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled “The Inklings,” was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today—with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**You can use the secure link below to receive instant access to “The Inklings” free video series:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca/](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjIzMjg2LWQzOGQ3ZDU2M2Y5NjQ4MjhiMWFhYmViM2QyNWI2NzJkIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjMiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2xwLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvdGhlLWlua2xpbmdzLWNjYS8_c2M9MDAyOTdOMDI0MkwwNkRPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWlua2xpbmdzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWltYWdlX0FFX0ZBTFI0MzU2NCJ9/cDvhLY1H3TREkVAuFKZ4JA)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings’ meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today’s “cancel culture.”

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That’s why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you’ll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien met regularly with an informal literary group named the Inklings.

Now, you can examine the philosophical, theological, and literary ideas that bound the Inklings together with a free video series from Hillsdale College.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings using this secure link:**

name: Read/Act News
subject: “It is essential that public opinion should be enlightened.”
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

Today, in our nation, there is an increased effort to strip America’s classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation’s history, and silence debate on the most important issues.

In times like these, I am reminded of George Washington’s Farewell Address, where he argued that “virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government.” For this reason, he said, “it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened.”

Washington understood that the preservation of liberty not only depended upon Americans courageous enough to defend their rights against people who would take their liberty but also who were knowledgeable about their history, their rights, and their form of government.

If you want the knowledge necessary to defend our freedom and help stop this movement to transform our nation, I urge you to enroll in our free online course, “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution.”

In this free course, you’ll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty; you’ll discover how the American Founders developed the freest government in human history from this timeless understanding of politics and human nature; and you’ll study how this form of government has been undermined for more than a century and the great threats we face today.

Most importantly, you’ll be armed with the knowledge and confidence to defend liberty in the face of modern efforts to control and silence the American people.

You can start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn by clicking the link below.

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](http://trk.readactnews.)

Warm regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College**

body:
In this free course, you’ll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zimcdddt8e2cii8ddj1ohcsi7t2fplojkrbdqv3o_rp22sh2s8i66p77chie8oj4cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

Today, in our nation, there is an increased effort to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and silence debate on the most important issues.

In times like these, I am reminded of George Washington's Farewell Address, where he argued that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government." For this reason, he said, "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened."

Washington understood that the preservation of liberty not only depended upon Americans courageous enough to defend their rights against people who would take their liberty but also who were knowledgeable about their history, their rights, and their form of government.

If you want the knowledge necessary to defend our freedom and help stop this movement to transform our nation, I urge you to enroll in our free online course, "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution."

In this free course, you'll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty; you'll discover how the American Founders developed the freest government in human history from this timeless understanding of politics and human nature; and you'll study how this form of government has been undermined for more than a century and the great threats we face today.

Most importantly, you'll be armed with the knowledge and confidence to defend liberty in the face of modern efforts to control and silence the American people.

You can start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn by clicking the link below.

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsjqpeusdnleop8ic70g82ihidsrolqrmbrrf7bo_rp22sh2s8i66p77chie8oj4cjh2bs)

Warm regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College **

Friend,

I wanted to take a moment to connect with you on a personal level and say thank you.

Over the last few days, my campaign momentum has continued to grow stronger.

Whether it’s the rise in the polls, our Q3 fundraising numbers of _**$11 MILLION**_ , or the endorsement I received, last night, from a fellow Republican who decided to end their campaign for President and support mine.

We’re seeing a fantastic surge of support coming our way, and It's been nothing short of incredible.

**Every time we rise in the polls, every time we crush our fundraising numbers, and every time we receive an endorsement -** it's a clear indication that our vision for America is deeply resonating with the American people.

**[Would you consider making a contribution to help us keep this momentum going strong?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24021%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G2a8wEqbFtgUOjzp7xKgFA&sysid=1 "Would you consider making
a contribution to help us keep this momentum going strong?")**

---

I’m so proud of what we are accomplishing together, but our work is far from over. We must continue the momentum, never let up, and keep pouring 100% into every day.

**With 95 DAYS remaining until the first votes are cast, the stakes have never been higher. **

**[With your support, we will continue the momentum, we will win the White House, and we WILL make America strong and proud again.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24023%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OVJlGHXxZGsXFog1Ed7yTg&sysid=1 "With your support, we will
continue the momentum, we will win the White House, and we WILL make America
strong and proud again. ")**

As president, I will focus on the issues that **MATTER** like our skyrocketing debt, out-of-control government spending, lack of transparency in schools, high crime in our cities, and chaos on the southern border.

_We have a country to save, but I need your help to make it happen._

I assure you that your dedication and commitment to a better future will never go unnoticed. Thank you for standing with me, and thank you for believing that America is worth fighting for!

**[I can't wait to have you with us as we work tirelessly to win the battle for our future.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24024%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fAvbtx%2b9QrNdPPLQEunjTg&sysid=1 "I can't wait to have you
with us as we work tirelessly to win the battle for our future.")**

---
My very best,

| | **More About Nikki Haley**

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24037%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8oLMz3HSQVivUj4XAILNiA&sysid=1 "NikkiHaley_Podium")
---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24038%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Dr7AjSZRCQUcDYA8BjUFUQ&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and

_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_
---
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjb0f5nfkp4jd8cktbr4mqr3jl8lq4mfvuqi3s6g_rp22sh2s8i66p77c9g64o36chh2bs)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

## **Scalise Resigns From Speaker Race**
In an unexpected turn of events, House Majority Leader [Steve Scalise dropped out of the race](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL8GOke7tjFQULwmXV57Jdqsl-DEYGT7EuXvT7n6ytE0o_m6zBcKMey3_7TJVJc0E9fwlBlBoVHazLb10yKixbQyoRt7DTiAbtfJcz86dgs773tAa8l4WjoiQ8730rVh0qANAhoYOwfDCVmQrnYgQLDor40F8aGmfLqnsNdVlvhOT8knTlsbp7XWozTmX6PPjT7TscurfNQHcg0cpdHnhzzDrjZmynV9q_RdqnhVDqGHZHVP2dOuClMMRRTaUTO5azc4sNwhDg6wY22WXhZm3-bJH68QYyiubyzcNgrxt6b-PecnAAD__9EuZc0) for House speaker last night. He made this decision following a closed-door meeting with fellow House Republicans. In a press conference following the decision, the Louisiana congressman called for the Republican Party to come together for the country over its own members' political agendas. He then added that he would push for a new speaker to be elected as quickly as possible. Scalise won his nomination by a slim majority in the Republican conference vote on Wednesday. However, many in the party [expressed intent to protest](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp8Gb1j3Xgh2BoYu3tK1o8XPTUxLjGVIrLx9lc7dPunT0ZHO12W-uJTTevt0d7btWmYXWnryjCBRSVKz7qK9MhOrji2a80CAI1C3WFJBOVKD0zBiVIEG480paERj4njyXbIEpBBQwflkYOwxMDqvRwcIGqMXGjimVvb-u6S1LXzNr_LkvQ_l3mW7tLZVoT4ETYKm4zj64OvKR33_gqb3FDQt5VFZ1o3dD--yNn6yrMHlVFmWbSuVo_Qv2RauLHfeHj6n4NY32u02bkfKOVUzCA23u0v5z97-j_EbAAD___kUYcg) the nomination and delay the actual election.

[NATO has committed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FyAiEQQL8GOm52AfUsKNLYmTblzXq7KBkEBxgv_n3G1GnfK968r_NyppRTuX7SXcKIdaF1pKcsCAadsW7xmkMUseK0BNwfDxZwBqtvQeKFd7haZnZxRYo79A6AfHTH2dKsU7BgHQI6OO72ME-4CtLFzwQIHvmiPAinUdv0XVMZN4n5VZ_SprXedQ63MR5duQ9lT8qetm2bYv0psvW3f5PaMit7KjRqN1mIpZlOr25SbyTZcJVuSh2mDypsKNciugV-bCnn1PcH5eF6p5T_guP__98AAAD__wDnXiE) to sending the munitions that Israel will need in its emerging war with Hamas. U.S. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin says America will be sending "security assistance" in the form of provisions and equipment to Isreal without any conditions. NATO Secretary-General Jens Stoltenberg has specifically named both Iran and Hezbollah as possibly lending a hand in Saturday's attacks, though Iran continues to dispute these claims. Many NATO member nations have pledged assistance for Israel. This comes after NATO spent the last 18 months being very [cautious about arming Ukraine](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQANCvwRsWnHGCB4Yu3tK1o3WBc3wthghoLPfrK3XuHzy9j9tyQ46cHu-4k2trXtA3ftGildSDhGExXXArEdDQkdOX6QpKWwXd5sAav45oYESyV0OII9hJT361YZqC6tiBgkErPahpvCjba08a78ai0srocBdGUeCWS_-ZObWN1njmF5Xe572LbmvtWcXwJmAWMB_H0T9z5MY-9_QtYMbS2EcSMCdsWd7Rf1XJtSBFiSnIA0uqkgsm2bKsDU-JB57ygT8oN9yxykQN04mbgLkrLjwPjpHr5SqMeuzI8U_S_o_5DQAA__84k2ZW) or sending Kyiv the munitions needed to fight the war against Russia.

## Autoworker Strike Intensifies
The United Auto Workers (UAW) union has [significantly ramped up its strike efforts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvwyAQRn8NbFh3h0OcgaGLt3TtaIE5EhpsLJvEzb-v3LnLt3zSe3pf1-HqUk7z7dNNbGssgxtrevGAoFAr0kMrg43MxFqyRXM5E2AHJO_Wo8dTMEjRnOHiQYcOgw46oCGM7GWyBKQRUMPlZKBrcGR0vu0cILQYvGiBQ6plbb5LmuudY36XF6_NWCaZ7b3WZRP6Q1AvqN_3vXE_qWzHK6g_2IJ6hGNQUP90u9rqmh6sYlmDevBcn-PjrZbs5ipXG5Y95Zw2cxYt3CaX8p-o_t_9GwAA__-H6Vfc) against the Detroit Three after 8,700 more workers walked off the job at a Ford plant in Kentucky on Wednesday. This unexpected action effectively disabled the most profitable Ford plant in the world. Executives at Ford didn't offer any amendments to their current economic position but did respond that they are working to potentially cover electric vehicle plants in the UAW national contract. This was not enough to quell the walkout. Since the beginning of this strike, the three major Detroit automakers [have laid off 4,800](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFvgzAQRn-N2YzuzkBg8NCFLV07ogPOwa2DI-zEyr-v6Nztk74nPb2v63RlH_x---S72OzixEv2L5kQNBpNZmqq1ToRElOJxW64EGAPVG127rntCDqaezZicIWhHWBucXF0aResvCUgg4AGhraDvsZFkOemZ0BocJ1VA7L6HI_6O_o9b-LCO77kqJd4r4Ldcn4kZT4UjYrGUkq9zGmXks5f0XhOReOTi0758D-in4-Vs-i0cdm1Y7_rwO_o3IlVh10fxYfgU3dRDdzu7MOfKf8f_hsAAP__e6VaFA) workers at non-striking plants. Auto executives report that the strikes have forced their hands on the matter.

name: Your America
subject: Deepen your understanding of the Constitution
body:
Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course

| This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24155%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=T%2fXXsWnerSClkKHYHuA0Dw&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

As we witness increased efforts to strip America’s classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation’s history, and stifle important debates, the need for informed citizens is urgent and obvious.

Our Founders understood this when they established our free nation. In his Farewell Address, George Washington stressed that “virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government” and that “it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened.”

Without a firm grasp of the Constitution and America’s founding principles, we cannot stand firm against the threats facing the nation today.

That’s why Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course: “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution.”

In this self-paced course, you’ll:

* Understand the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty.
* Explore how our Founders shaped the freest government in human history.
* Examine the challenges our form of government has faced over the past century and the threats we confront today.

After completing this course, you’ll understand why our Founders built the greatest nation in human history and why we must preserve it.

Follow this secure link to start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn within minutes:

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c24156%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0goUvIfH0xyUEQjkvH8Ybg&sysid=1)

Warm regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College **

body:
In this free course, you'll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=abbf910ee4d942b8bc935e97d5f73368&_e=KgW-JdDQlWLCS-NJb90jCCLU_3lzGOaz10zqoyQvatB_F5oQPaSCZQZPDBbA-YY14V0YQSULkAhNSgZkl7CllcGRlwEkNeuBPh8bEarDzdQ5sLXaD7y7KEiWwBKK3DTSETe7WmFe3XCXE1sGxGLcb_skL1bVp7WIqxNY33TF9irLY47wyVJUqZCtOm_9WyJqONPYq0HUa62VVLGCrUQA-tzRNof0wZhme48Ev1IM6rYdzdVHf95-NDfl4jrnY13gF3DKhGxxi-0RNGZQz_lm-sM10qtuYpJsxEntP5PBUntlrlO0Xazkj5S0CMAGs8hGaD4B-xD8pfJh9_obUESvLxwXIUGQDfAuSiIKqfxpEPF3qm-mG7KFPG7bnmseVq_xnqSEiylVycHjRn7ZdNzLwA%3D%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American,

Today, in our nation, there is an increased effort to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and silence debate on the most important issues.

In times like these, I am reminded of George Washington's Farewell Address, where he argued that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government." For this reason, he said, "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened."

Washington understood that the preservation of liberty not only depended upon Americans courageous enough to defend their rights against people who would take their liberty but also who were knowledgeable about their history, their rights, and their form of government.

If you want the knowledge necessary to defend our freedom and help stop this movement to transform our nation, I urge you to enroll in our free online course, "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution."

In this free course, you'll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty; you'll discover how the American Founders developed the freest government in human history from this timeless understanding of politics and human nature; and you'll study how this form of government has been undermined for more than a century and the great threats we face today.

Most importantly, you'll be armed with the knowledge and confidence to defend liberty in the face of modern efforts to control and silence the American people.

You can start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn by clicking the link below.

[https://online.hillsdale.edu/register/constitution-101](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=abbf910ee4d942b8bc935e97d5f73368&_e=KgW-JdDQlWLCS-NJb90jCCLU_3lzGOaz10zqoyQvatB_F5oQPaSCZQZPDBbA-YY14V0YQSULkAhNSgZkl7CllcGRlwEkNeuBPh8bEarDzdQ5sLXaD7y7KEiWwBKK3DTSETe7WmFe3XCXE1sGxGLcb_skL1bVp7WIqxNY33TF9irLY47wyVJUqZCtOm_9WyJqONPYq0HUa62VVLGCrUQA-tzRNof0wZhme48Ev1IM6rYdzdVHf95-NDfl4jrnY13gjcYtEvq5lRG11j1I1U_LQX5-3_BcKygw8B8ldK_KVuyFfud9sbPvjGFREML9CzqzUrkHl8UxUZI_aKCO8azj1M6kNgrKChkV0LABxwpzE8YgMer2jKxGc5j9nqdnmzXZisjcoaNm6BfTIaoFwH-WqA%3D%3D)

Warm regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning

clean_body: In this free course, you'll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Fellow American, Today, in our nation, there is an increased effort to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and silence debate on the most important issues. In times like these, I am reminded of George Washington's Farewell Address, where he argued that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government." For this reason, he said, "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened." Washington understood that the preservation of liberty not only depended upon Americans courageous enough to defend their rights against people who would take their liberty but also who were knowledgeable about their history, their rights, and their form of government. If you want the knowledge necessary to defend our freedom and help stop this movement to transform our nation, I urge you to enroll in our free online course, "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution." In this free course, you'll learn the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty; you'll discover how the American Founders developed the freest government in human history from this timeless understanding of politics and human nature; and you'll study how this form of government has been undermined for more than a century and the great threats we face today. Most importantly, you'll be armed with the knowledge and confidence to defend liberty in the face of modern efforts to control and silence the American people. You can start the first lecture with Dr. Larry P. Arnn by clicking the link below. Warm regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College | | Freedom Nation Today 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 | _

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Whether it's the rise in the polls, our Q3 fundraising numbers of $11 MILLION , or the endorsement I received, last night, from a fellow Republican who decided to end their campaign for President and support mine. Every time we rise in the polls, every time we crush our fundraising numbers, and every time we receive an endorsement - it's a clear indication that our vision for America is deeply resonating with the American people. "Would you consider making a contribution to help us keep this momentum going strong?" | | | I'm so proud of what we are accomplishing together, but our work is far from over. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs, stood up for Israel even when others refused, and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future. A special partnership | | | | | |
---
[](https://mattbirk.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ce1d8ace27817bbd55d7ad20&id=b76633244f&e=b2e0e42b55)
|
---
Peter,
We’re just under a month away from Veteran’s Day. Our nation's veterans deserve our deepest thanks. It's essential not only to express our gratitude but also to acknowledge the physical and mental health challenges that many veterans face upon returning home. While their sacrifices on the battlefield are evident, the hidden battles within themselves often go unnoticed. That’s why I’m proud to be a partner at Heritage Gear, who’s teaming up with [Team Red, White and Blue](https://mattbirk.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ce1d8ace27817bbd55d7ad20&id=1193e4df96&e=b2e0e42b55). They provide veterans with real-life and virtual opportunities focused on building a healthier lifestyle - with a strong focus on supporting mental and physical health.
From now until Veteran's Day, when you buy a flag-themed [Waxed Canvas Weekender or Navy Wool Tote](https://mattbirk.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ce1d8ace27817bbd55d7ad20&id=2d4460dfa9&e=b2e0e42b55), 50% of the proceeds will go towards Team RWB. If you order before Veteran's Day, you'll have the bag in time for Christmas.
[](https://mattbirk.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ce1d8ace27817bbd55d7ad20&id=aac78d55bf&e=b2e0e42b55)
Not too long ago, I traveled Minnesota on the campaign trail and met so many who sacrificed for our country. I won’t forget the conversations I had and the lasting impact serving had on them.
If you have a veteran in your life, get [one of these bags](https://mattbirk.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ce1d8ace27817bbd55d7ad20&id=c3b733baa3&e=b2e0e42b55) and know that your money is going to a cause that will support the mental and physical health of other soldiers.

Sincerely,
Matt Birk

body:
And an explanation about why Josh Hawley doesn’t know a thing about it.
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas.
I know it’s early, but I wanted to take a moment this morning to share a story with you about the Missouri I grew up in — and why Josh Hawley doesn’t know a thing about it. **Will you please let me explain?**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38551?refcode=em20231013-3974&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3974%2E614464%2Eyei7AK)
On the right is Joshua Hawley. While his banker daddy was sending him to a fancy prep school miles from his hometown, my family and I were relying on our neighbors to survive bankruptcy and medical bills in mid-Missouri — in a community where people took care of each other. That’s us on the left.
When Hawley graduated from law school, he joined one of the world’s most elite corporate law firms. I joined the Marine Corps to pay back the community in Missouri that took care of me and my family. And when he was climbing the ladder to become another corrupt politician, I was serving my country — and then working to prevent the pointless overseas wars that make us less safe.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38551?refcode=em20231013-3974&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3974%2E614464%2Eyei7AK)
While Josh Hawley aligned himself with the same giant corporations who’ve spent decades attacking Missouri workers and shipping away our jobs, I’ve been fighting to take back power for American workers and small businesses.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38551?refcode=em20231013-3974&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3974%2E614464%2Eyei7AK)
And when Hawley voted against relief for veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits, I stood up alongside thousands of veterans to hold him accountable.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38551?refcode=em20231013-3974&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3974%2E614464%2Eyei7AK)
**The Missouri I grew up in taught us to take care of one another.** To do your duty. To serve and sacrifice for your fellow Missourians.
**Josh Hawley doesn’t know that Missouri — and on January 6th, 2021, he showed us the only thing he’s learned is how to be a fraud and a coward.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/38551?refcode=em20231013-3974&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3974%2E614464%2Eyei7AK)
Josh Hawley hasn't just abandoned our state and our values. He's embarrassed himself and all of Missouri. And embarrassing Missouri... That’s something I can't let go.
**Missourians deserve a US Senator who will stand up and fight for them — and unlike Josh, I'm ready to serve.** If you’re ready to help us make sure every Missouri voter knows it before they vote on Election Day, I need your help:
**[Will you chip in any amount you can afford to our campaign right now so we can get our message in front of voters? | | It’s no secret that Black voters have been the target of voter suppression efforts throughout American history. There’s a long, painful history of preventing Black voters from accessing the ballot box.
Even after the 15th Amendment was ratified and extended the freedom to vote to Black men, Black voters in Georgia and across the South were still denied the right to vote for nearly a century, facing poll taxes, literacy tests, and violent threats from the KKK if they attempted to vote.
The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was passed to remove Jim Crow-era barriers, and it ushered in a new era of Black political participation, but the Supreme Court has been gutting the law’s protections for the past decade. Some cowardly and bigoted lawmakers are still determined to place hurdles between Black voters and the ballot box because they’re afraid they’d lose their power once Black Americans are able to fully use theirs.
**But no matter the obstacles that anti-voter extremists throw in our way, Fair Fight Action will remain committed to helping Black voters maintain their registrations, get out to vote, and have that vote counted. And supporters like you make it possible.** **_[Chip in anything you can to help build even stronger Black voting power in the South.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71487447/432291645/-246774915?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20231013_f_redistricting2_v1s3&ms=bsc_emm_ffa_20231013_f_redistricting2_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MGNlMzkyMi1jODY5LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wKAaYoVXLtXuyIq65pVO0tt3s2AByEUdSDjdnNjT1EY=)_**

Fair Fight Action works to build and strengthen the voting power of communities of color, especially in the South — so we’ll continue to advocate against laws that seek to silence Black voters. And when polling locations or ID requirements change, or if issues arise in the voting process, we’ll continue to reach voters with the resources they need to cast their ballots. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- There’s a long, painful history of preventing Black voters from accessing the ballot box. Even after the 15th Amendment was ratified and extended the freedom to vote to Black men, Black voters in Georgia and across the South were still denied the right to vote for nearly a century, facing poll taxes, literacy tests, and violent threats from the KKK if they attempted to vote. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was passed to remove Jim Crow-era barriers, and it ushered in a new era of Black political participation, but the Supreme Court has been gutting the law’s protections for the past decade. Some cowardly and bigoted lawmakers are still determined to place hurdles between Black voters and the ballot box because they’re afraid they’d lose their power once Black Americans are able to fully use theirs. | | Dear Fellow American,

As we witness increased efforts to strip America's classrooms of civic education, rewrite our nation's history, and stifle important debates, the need for informed citizens is urgent and obvious.

Our Founders understood this when they established our free nation. In his Farewell Address, George Washington stressed that "virtue or morality is the necessary spring of popular government" and that "it is essential that public opinion should be enlightened."

Without a firm grasp of the Constitution and America's founding principles, we cannot stand firm against the threats facing the nation today.

That's why Hillsdale College invites all Americans to take this FREE online course: "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution."

In this self-paced course, you'll:

* Understand the meaning of equality, natural law, consent, representation, and sovereignty.
* Explore how our Founders shaped the freest government in human history.
* Examine the challenges our form of government has faced over the past century and the threats we confront today.

After completing this course, you'll understand why our Founders built the greatest nation in human history and why we must preserve it.

Dear Friend,
As a member of Harrisburg City Council, I know that governing can be hard. My colleagues and I frequently disagree about the best direction for the city, and the debates can be fierce. Whatever our disagreements may be, we all understand that at the end of the day the people we represent are counting on us to deliver results and get the job done, and we do. Unfortunately, the same cannot be said for the House GOP.
Had enough of the House GOP's dysfunction? Ready for government that works? Make a contribution to our campaign so we can elect a Representative to Congress who will get the job done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Amid the outbreak of war in the Middle East, and (another) looming deadline for a government shutdown, the House GOP is unable to even elect a Speaker so that they can conduct business. At the heart of the conflict over House leadership is . . . you guessed it . . . the radical, pro-MAGA Freedom Caucus. These extremists don't want government that works. They want to burn it all down. While he is good at staying out of the headlines, depending on his flunkies like Matt Gaetz and Jim Jordan to do his dirty work, we can't forget that when it comes to the "Chaos Caucus," all roads lead back to their leader, Scott Perry.
If you've had enough of the dangerous antics of the Freedom Caucus and their leader, Scott Perry, please make a contribution to support our campaign to defeat Scott Perry. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Here are the facts. Perry and his cohorts have ground the House to a halt. They aren't even meeting the bare minimum expectations for the job they were elected to do. I can't do that as a member of City Council or as an attorney, and you can't do it at your job either. If the rest of us fail to do our job, we get fired. It's time that Scott Perry had a dose of the real world. In order to fire Freedom Caucus Chair Scott Perry, we need to defeat him next November.
Let's give Scott Perry a dose of reality. If he can't do his job (which he obviously can't), we need to fire him and hire someone who can. I'm asking for your support so I can go to Washington and get the job done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With continuing gratitude,
Shamaine

**Dear Friend** ,
Clean water is something many people will take for granted until it disappears. That makes it exactly the kind of issue that many politicians will ignore or even work against if it means getting a few contributions from polluters.

On a national level, Congress has a responsibility to protect our waterways by funding the agencies that monitor and regulate pollution. And yet, just the other week the House Republicans passed a bill that would gut the Environmental Protection Agency.

Here at home, a sensible, affordable plan to improve water quality by upgrading sewers and septic systems in Suffolk seemed poised to reach the voters via referendum until the GOP-dominated legislature blocked it. That’s a loss for Suffolk families, and just one of many reasons why I’m working hard to elect County Executive candidate Dave Calone along with many of our Democratic County Legislative candidates.

It’s important to look at how candidates would handle the less flashy issues if you want to know who they really are. Clean water is personal for me – I was Suffolk County Water Chair for a decade and raised standards so that our water at the time was among the cleanest in the country. But any elected official in Suffolk County should have a clear position on how they’ll defend our most precious resource for future generations.

I hope you’re planning to vote this November. [And if you believe in the cause of clean water, I wouldn’t mind a donation for my campaign for Congress either!](https://gaughran2020.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da1ef5330c259be898aff5d12&id=5684411851&e=a6aa651d40)

Jim

name: Rep. Park Cannon
subject: The right to choose is a human right.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Georgia Blue PAC
body:
Peter,

Dance has always been a part of my life. I love modern dance and use it as a healing practice. I’ve also toured with NYC dance companies and created dance pieces about reproductive justice.

Why that topic for dance? Because, in my years working as an advocate for Black women’s health, I’ve seen exactly what happens when women can’t make their own choices about reproductive health. More disability, more death. Particularly for women of color.

Mark my words: By taking away choice, the radical GOP is waging an attack on women.

How do we put a stop to this? By electing candidates who share your values. Georgia House Dems supported me as a young candidate, and I urge you to support Georgia House Democrats as they work to find more future candidates who are like me: Young, politicized, and motivated by human rights rather than dark money.

Every dollar you donate helps support policies and candidates who can help us restore our majority in the Georgia House.

Best,

Park Cannon

name: LTC(R) Christian Castelli
subject: Border security can't wait any longer.
body:
Dear Peter,

Joe Biden and Democrats have failed America.

Our southern border is severely exposed. It is a welcome invitation to our enemies, drug cartels and illegal immigrants to creep into our homeland.

Securing the border can no longer wait. We must close and defend it. It is a mission which needs to be accomplished. Now!

[](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)

_I 'm Christian Castelli. My military service includes, 22 years as a decorated soldier, Green Beret, and senior advisor at The Pentagon._

It is not in my nature to leave challenges and problems unresolved.

I trained, studied, prepared and then trained, studied, and prepared again and again to make sure I could meet the challenges in front of me and complete the mission I was called to carry out.

America's mission right now must be to close and secure our border.

_If we don 't secure our border, we leave our schools, churches, synagogues, gathering places, and homeland vulnerable to our enemies that wish to do us harm, drug cartels who want to destroy our youth and communities, and illegal immigrants who drain our economy of resources. _

I am running for Congress, because we need experienced, proven, tested and conservative leaders to take on the mission to secure our border.

I will:
* Finish building the wall
* Double our Border Patrol agents
* Provide the best technology, surveillance and intelligence to make sure our border is not vulnerable.

**Join me. Please make a contribution today of $500, $250, $100, $50, $25 or whatever you can today**.

Together, we can keep America, our communities, schools, churches, synagogues, and gathering places safe.

[](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)
R. Christian Castelli
Lieutenant Colonel (Retired)
U.S. Army Special Forces
Republican Candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives
(336) 810-8100

**_" Surrender is not a Ranger word." \- from the Ranger's Creed_**
This email was sent to **dpwillis67@gmail.com** from **colonel@castellifornc.com**.
If you do not wish to receive further messages from us, [ please click here to unsubscribe](https://emailtracking-cm.aristotle.com/frmEmailUnsubscribe.aspx?databaseId=b33a3810-9cbf-4584-a3d2-01672886537a&activityID=23a37d4c-161a-4eb3-9d74-9960ad8482cf).

Friend,
Remember when I chose to go to Michigan to deliver a speech directly to the PEOPLE on how I’ll save our country rather than attend the GOP debate?
And remember when the so-called experts in Washington said I was making a big mistake?
Well, take a look at this new poll out of Michigan...
**DETROIT NEWS: TRUMP NOW LEADS JOE BIDEN BY 7 POINTS IN MICHIGAN**
By now, I think we can safely say I made the RIGHT DECISION by saying “no thank you” to the offer to attend the last debate.
So, for everyone out there who is keeping score of how many times I’ve been right on so many different topics over the years, I think we’re currently sitting at a very high number.
But before the Fake News says, “There he goes again. Trump can’t stop bragging” – I want to make something clear... I don’t say any of this to brag.
The truth is: _**I am not alone in being right so often.**_
I only say things that the vast (silent) MAJORITY of Americans agree with. And the majority of Americans have a lot more sense than all of the experts in Washington – COMBINED!
All decent and patriotic citizens agree that our borders should be secure, that a travel ban that restricts immigration from nations compromised by radical Islamic terrorism is a smart idea, that we should drill for oil on our own land, that we should pursue a foreign policy that promotes peace and stability, that we shouldn’t keep burning through taxpayer dollars when inflation is killing us, and that letting violent criminals out of jail is a dangerously stupid idea.
Right now, our country needs real leadership. We need someone who is unafraid to say what all Americans are thinking. We need someone with an independent mind who will ignore the Washington experts and do what’s right for our country. We need a leader who has the courage to defy the powers-that-be and implement a bold vision to Make America Great Again!
_**If you are ready for that leader, then I am humbly asking for your support to win back the White House and SAVE AMERICA.**_

subject: Prescott’s campaign finishes Q3 with over $460k
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: October 13, 2023
---
| Contact: Derek Dufresne derek@ascent-strategic.com; 202-809-6013
---
| Prescott's Campaign Finishes Q3 with Over $460k
---
| Exeter, NH \- Finishing out his first fundraising quarter, Russell Prescott will show that his congressional campaign has taken in over $460,000 in Q3, including money that he has personally put into the race.
In addition to starting off the campaign in an incredibly strong financial position, Prescott has been releasing scores of endorsements from top New Hampshire leaders. Yesterday, he also announced additional members of his growing campaign team.
In response, Russell Prescott stated:
"Ensuring we have the resources necessary to wage a strong campaign is crucial to winning this seat. I am humbled by the support we have earned thus far, and I am encouraged by the momentum we are seeing as we begin the next fundraising quarter."
---
|
---
| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.
---

body:
I wanted to share a few thoughts with you. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e7428fcae270/a-new-way-forward-for-texas-12656263?e=b8ba94fd9b)
---
Peter,
Hi! My name is Gloria Martinez-Tchenko. I’m Thierry’s wife. And partner in all things.
I’m also a proud Hispanic woman, born in Nicaragua.
Hispanic Heritage Month is currently winding down and I wanted to take a quick moment to check in and introduce myself.

[](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=34db120816&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Thierry is driving across Texas, visiting as many counties as possible and talking with folks about A New Way Forward that focuses on serving everyday Texans instead of corporations and special interests.
And I’ve been so fortunate to join him every step of the way.
We’ve been meeting Texans where they are, regardless of color, religion, zip code, or economic status.
**Because like me, Thierry believes that everyone deserves a shot at a better life.**
Throughout our travels, we’ve met so many fellow Hispanics, and I’ve loved digging even deeper into my already strong roots and seeing just how vibrant and diverse the Hispanic community is throughout the great state of Texas.
Hispanic Heritage Month celebrates the histories, cultures, and contributions of those whose ancestors came from Spain, Mexico, the Caribbean and Central and South America.
And here in Texas, the essence of Hispanic roots is ever-present, shaping our communities with tenacity, creativity, and enduring spirit. Our legacy is woven into the shared American story, reminding us of the strength that comes from diversity.
**I’m so proud to be supporting my husband on this journey to help lift up all Texans, regardless of where they were born or what language they speak at home.**
[**If you’re with Team Tchenko, please kick in $20.24 or more today. Every dollar we raise helps keep us on the road, talking to Texans and building our winning grassroots coalition.**](https://tchenkofortexas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=93f02de4b9a588e8269491419&id=932e852164&e=b8ba94fd9b)
Mil Gracias,Gloria

Hi Derek, I have far-right Republicans running against me. They're trying to represent my home in Western PA where their extreme agenda is everything I'm fighting against. Let me be clear: I won't let them win. **The rot and extremism on the far right has infected the GOP so badly that they’ll attack anyone, even for their patriotism.** These people support a corrupt former president who dodged the draft and thinks heroes who died in battle are “suckers” and “losers.” **Republicans are backing the Trumpers** who threatened our democracy and are holding the House hostage for their political games. And they have proposed huge cuts to the VA, selling out my fellow veterans, including those who were exposed to burn pits. The GOP needs to take a hard look in the mirror because they're failing the American people. **I was taught to serve our country, protect our freedom, and be proud to defend our democracy. Why? _Because I’m an organizer at heart, and I know the difference that young organizers can make in shaping our future._

For young people in Florida, the stakes are higher than ever. Our youth are constantly being attacked by Ron DeSantis and his fascist policies.

But we’re fighting back against fascism the best way we know how: **by building up our organizing teams and bringing more young people into our movement for progress in Florida.** Our team of paid student fellows are organizing in the district, engaging with community members, and mobilizing other students on college campuses across the state. **Our youth-powered organizing program is the best chance we have at defeating Ron DeSantis’ fascism, but we need your grassroots support to keep up the work.** [_**If we want to keep our organizing teams going across Florida, we need YOU to help power this movement before my weekly fundraising deadline at midnight. Will you chip in $27 to help us fully fund our organizing program, so we can defeat DeSantis and his fascist agenda in Florida? >>**_](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/869mMk7nLdDyL8HRku3UqA~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRnC_S8P0TOaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMTAxM19lbV9mcl9iMV9mYWxsX2ZlbGxvd3NfZW4mYW1vdW50PTI3JmNkbWM9MldpS1RIUmdudnJmemQzdHYwOGM2eXBmVjBYJnJlZmNvZGUyPTJXaUtUSFJnbnZyZnpkM3R2MDhjNnlwZlYwWCZyZWZjb2RlY2RtYz0yV2lLVEhSZ252cmZ6ZDN0djA4YzZ5cGZWMFhXA3NwY0IKZSC8byllS5IF7FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAGk~) [](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/869mMk7nLdDyL8HRku3UqA~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRnC_S8P0TOaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL21hZi1lbS1wZ2U_cmVmY29kZT0yMDIzMTAxM19lbV9mcl9iMV9mYWxsX2ZlbGxvd3NfZW4mYW1vdW50PTI3JmNkbWM9MldpS1RIUmdudnJmemQzdHYwOGM2eXBmVjBYJnJlZmNvZGUyPTJXaUtUSFJnbnZyZnpkM3R2MDhjNnlwZlYwWCZyZWZjb2RlY2RtYz0yV2lLVEhSZ252cmZ6ZDN0djA4YzZ5cGZWMFhXA3NwY0IKZSC8byllS5IF7FIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAGk~) Peter – before I ran for Congress, I was an organizer. I know how critical it is to have a strong, youth-powered movement pushing for real change.

And right now, young people in Florida are more empowered than ever. We won’t stand on the sidelines and watch our Sunshine State go up in flames at the hands of a far-right extremist.

Where's Biden? You can say whatever you want about Trump, but I would rather have him in charge in an emergency than Biden any day!

Like most Americans, I am a Christian and I am devastated beyond belief by the recent acts of terrorism in Israel. Hamas terrorists do not value life and have confirmed evil is still at the front door by brutally killing innocent civilians in Israel.

Please pray for Israel and the Jewish people. For many Israelis, these are the hardest days of their life. Their friends and family members are gone or their kids are deployed.

During last weekend's attacks, Hamas terrorists killed more than 1,200 people, including babies, and killed at least 25 Americans. This would not have happened on President Trump's watch.

Sadly, these kinds of attacks could happen right here in US due to stupid and reckless Biden policies that allow millions of unknown people to illegally cross our southern border.

In Israel it is very difficult to own a gun. That explains why it was so easy for terrorists to mow down over 200 teenagers without concern for their own safety. Thank God we have our 2nd Amendment.

There are still unknown numbers of US and Israeli hostages -- and meanwhile radical socialist members of the Squad like Ilhan Omar and Rashida Tlaib are standing with Hamas and AGAINST Israel.

I'm sure by now you heard Several Universities are defending Hamas. Virginia Attorney General Jason Miyares condemned UVA's statement, saying he denounces the "hateful message" of the UVA Students for Justice in Palestine in the "strongest terms possible." He said, "You cannot 'mourn the loss of human life' and 'hope for long-lasting peace' and also cheer on the murder, rape, and hostage-taking by Hamas, a terrorist organization that exists for the destruction and murder of Jewish people."

These barbaric attacks have no place in the free world and Israel, our strongest ally, just like every nation, absolutely has a right to defend her people. I stand with Israel.

subject: ALERT: Chicago on High Alert during Global "Day of Anger"
body:
In the wake of calls by Hamas leaders for a global "Day of Anger" today, Chicagoland remains on High Alert during critical Israel vote at City Hall.

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/0238b34cc9d4/alert-chicago-on-high-alert-during-global-day-of-anger?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=7d8bb3b574) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=7d8bb3b574)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Hamas Leaders Call for a Global Day of Anger Friday Leaving Chicagoland Area and Major Cities Around the World on High Alert (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/10/hamas-leaders-call-for-a-global-day-of-anger-friday-leaving-chicagoland-area-and-major-cities-around-the-world-on-high-alert.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/10/hamas-leaders-call-for-a-global-day-of-anger-friday-leaving-chicagoland-area-and-major-cities-around-the-world-on-high-alert.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Police officers evacuate a woman and a child from a site hit by a rocket fired from the Gaza Strip, in Ashkelon, October 7, 2023. (AP Photo/Tsafrir Abayov)
With the death toll rising in Israel and the war with Hamas escalating, Hamas leader Khaled Mashal has called for a ‘Day of Rage (https://www.newsmax.com/us/nypd-global-day-of-anger-hamas/2023/10/12/id/1138118/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ’ around the world on Friday, leaving synagogues and law enforcement officials on high alert, including in the Chicagoland area where on Thursday, a temple in Skokie (https://abc7chicago.com/day-of-rage-chicago-october-13-hamas-2023-news/13906570/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) received a bomb threat and had to be evacuated.

Fortunately, no explosives were found after local police searched the temple, but the threats of terrorism and hate crime incidents remain a real threat following Hamas’ call to action earlier this week.

On Thursday, the Chicago Police Department issued a statement:

“Though there is no actionable intelligence regarding any credible threats in Chicago at this time, CPD is paying special attention to synagogues and mosques so that all of our residents are safe. We also remain in close communication with community leaders and elected officials.”

In
New York (https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/law-enforcement-patrols-jewish-synagogues-temples-businesses-rcna120055?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , law enforcement officials canceled police officer training on Thursday and directed that the entire force be in uniform and out on patrol as online threats against the Jewish community continue around the world and in the U.S.

Although there are no specific threats, New York Police Department officials wanted to exercise extreme caution.

The city of Los Angeles is taking a similar approach and local law enforcement officials have ordered the entire department to report for duty on Friday in uniform.

On Friday, the Chicago City Council is holding a special meeting where 50th Ward Alderman Debra Silverstein (D) – the only Jewish member on city council, is expected to present a resolution offering support for Israel in the wake of Hamas’ terrorist attack that has killed over 1,300 people so far.

The meeting is expected to generate a heated debate as some members, including 33rd Ward Alderman Rosanna Rodriguez-Sanchez (D), a member of the Democrat Socialist Caucus and several of her colleagues, would like the resolution to include support for Palestine as well.

In a post on X late Thursday evening, Rodriguez said that she would not be present at Friday’s meeting but that she hopes that her “colleagues understand what it means to stand with Israel’s right wing gov rn as they bomb civilians in Gaza.”
On Tuesday, Rodriguez shared a statement on X in support of U.S. Rep. Rashida Tlaiib (D-MI), who has come under heat in Washington for referring to Israel as an “apartheid government (https://thehill.com/homenews/house/4251115-hoyer-supports-tlaib-amid-hamas-attack-pushback/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ” and for failing to issue a harsh statement against Hamas and their heinous attacks on innocent Israeli civilians. Rodriguez wrote that she was “grateful for @RashidaTlaib’s leadership.”
Israeli Defense Forces have reported in the last several days that Hamas terrorists assassinated innocent civilians including men, women, children and babies. In some cases, Hamas fighters decapitated people, brutally murdered children while still in their beds and burned their little bodies, including babies. Photos released by the Israeli government show homes and children’s bedrooms riddled with bullets.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=7d8bb3b574-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_13_04_52&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7d8bb3b574-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friend,
The special interest “Republicans” (RINOs, as we like to call them) — who’ve already pledged $370 MILLION to try and stop us — were caught behind closed doors saying that they had “60 days” to take me down.
And now, with their self-imposed **deadline of October 24** looming over them and our LEAD only growing larger by the day, they’re panicking like never before.
In fact, one of the biggest RINOs of them all (a not-so-great senator from the great state of Utah) just personally begged his megadonors to spend millions more against us in this final stretch leading up to the FIRST contest of the primary.
As _The Washington Post_ put it, these RINOs are _**“alarmed by the dominance of Donald Trump.”**_
Friend, even the fake news has to be right once in a blue moon, and today’s their day, because we are indeed DOMINATING. We’re leading the Republican field by 62 points!
**But there is only one _REAL_ _mission_ : firing Crooked Joe Biden and SAVING AMERICA!**
_**And every minute these foolish RINOs spend attacking OUR beautiful movement is precious time and resources NOT spent going after Crooked Joe.**_

subject: Voting in-person for WA Republicans
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Washington State Republican Party
body:
Republicans across the state are leading the charge are bringing back voting in-person to Washington State. You can help support these efforts. | | | [ ](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=088a38ee72&e=6a281f566d)
---
| | Dear Peter,

For decades, Republicans have been asking to vote in-person again in Washington State. **Now you can.**

Republicans have also been worried about whether or not returning a ballot through the Post Office is trustworthy. **Now you don't have to worry about it.**

Over the last month, the Washington State Republican Party has launched a program called**'Secure Your Vote'. **

This program includes several steps that encourages Republicans to vote, promotes legal ballot harvesting, and **helps ensure that every vote is properly counted** at the county elections office.

We are aligned with local businesses, churches, fishing & wildlife shops and conservative leaning groups to organize **conservative ballot box centers **across the state. We are also establishing **grassroots conservative teams** who will help you verify that your ballot was returned and counted by the county elections.

Building the statewide infrastructure for**'Secure Your Vote'** is going to take a lot of grassroots power and resources.**The secure ballot boxes alone can cost up to $150 each - these aren't just a shoe box with a whole cut in it.** And they are accompanied with voter information & materials, ballot tracking, and trained grassroots volunteer teams.

Our first step is to train the grassroots conservative teams and to establish the secure ballot boxes. While we start with training, can you help us put in place more secure ballot boxes?

**With your support, we can hit our goal of 200 verified conservative ballot box centers before the 2024 statewide election.** That's $30,000 just for the secure ballot boxes alone, which we've already spent $4,000 of.

[_**Can you help us reach the last $26,000 with a grassroots contribution of $10, $25, or $50 today?**_](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=aa9863e2e2&e=6a281f566d)

---
| [Help fund conservative ballot box centers](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=6cc3ecf4e0&e=6a281f566d "Help fund conservative ballot box centers")
---
| Grassroots conservatives are already hard at work in all 39 counties and**here are some of the success stories** so far:

\- 9 conservative ballot boxes in Pierce county with 8 more on the way.

\- 3 In-person voting events organized in Central WA with 8 ballot boxes being deployed this week.

\- 15 churches have established conservative ballot box centers with hundreds of pastors encouraging voting within their congregations.

\- tens-of-thousands of phone calls and text messages are being launched to conservative voters for the 2023 local elections to connect them with our trained and verified grassroots volunteers.

Not every county and district has a fully operational ballot box center yet, or a team of trained and verified grassroots conservatives helping voters secure their vote. We will keep growing. And continue building. **And with your support, by next year we can hit our goal of 200 verified conservative ballot box centers in Washington State.**
---
| [Help fund conservative ballot box centers](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=8d5e58fb54&e=6a281f566d "Help fund conservative ballot box centers")
---
|
---
| | **Ballot harvesting is legal in Washington State. **Democrats have already been doing it in the shadows to win elections for the last decade.

Republicans in Washington State must start the effort now if we want to win close races for the foreseeable future. We will do it as aggressively as possible. We will conduct our efforts legally and with integrity. And in doing so, **we will start winning again!**

Please support our efforts today to bring this important change to the way our Party operates campaigns. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Jim Walsh
Chairman
Washington State Republican Party

In politics, we can’t take anything for granted. **While it’s true the environment favors our party retaking the Senate in 2024,_things can change in the blink of an eye._**

I remember well the night that Al Gore – having previously conceded the presidency – called to tell Texas Gov. George W. Bush that he was withdrawing his concession and would take the fight over who won Florida to the U.S. Supreme Court.

A more recent example of why elections matter would be the 2021 Georgia Senate runoffs. Had Republicans held onto those seats, America won’t not be in the “transitory” phase of inflation we’re in today. **A Republican majority would have blocked Biden’s $1.9 TRILLION “American Rescue Plan.” that set inflation raging.**

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| |
# _Growing and Improving Party Operations_
---
---
Team, Your Indiana Republican State Committee is committed to growing and improving our party operations. We understand that in order to do that, we have to empower our grassroots leaders with the best tools possible to help get Republicans elected up and down the ballot. One way that we were able to do that recently was through an opportunity with the Republican National Committee called the County Chair Fly In, a conference the RNC held in Kansas City. At this conference, the RNC allows each state to send up to three county chairs to come network and learn some of the new and best strategies to help our candidates win. Representing us were Johnson County Chair Beth Boyce, Montgomery County Chair Jim Johnson and Noble County Chair Shelly Williams. While at this training, they were able to network with many of their peers from across the country and learn some new ways to help candidates across our state. They were able to hear in-depth presentations on how to improve our communications, data, digital, and fundraising efforts. They were also able to hear from RNC leadership about our increased efforts to promote ["banking your vote"](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/3814da152f395706c3d6b838967d376c/40313) in 2023 and beyond. I want to thank our county chairs for taking the time to go this important training, and for the tools and knowledge they brought back to help the Indiana GOP continue to grow. We look forward to partnering in training opportunities throughout the state, and ultimately are looking forward to seeing many of you at Congress of Counties in February where we will share these tools, techniques, and have the opportunity to refine our best practices. As always, thank you for all you do to make our party and our state thrive!

Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# **🚗 _Gov. Holcomb announces second Stellantis, Samsung SDI EV battery manufacturing facility, $3.2B investment_** __
---
---
| | Governor Eric J. Holcomb announced today that Stellantis (NYSE: STLA) and Samsung SDI will significantly expand electric vehicle battery manufacturing operations in Indiana, investing more than $3.2 billion. The facility will be the joint venture’s second StarPlus Energy gigafactory in Kokomo. To support this growth, the companies plan to create 1,400 new, high-wage jobs in north central Indiana, growing its total planned workforce to 2,800 jobs. “Indiana’s economy is on a roll,” said Gov. Holcomb. “Today’s commitment from Stellantis and Samsung SDI will double the capital investment, the new jobs created, and the impact this joint venture will have on Kokomo and the state of Indiana for decades to come. This decision puts Hoosiers squarely at the center of innovating and developing the future of mobility, catalyzing Indiana’s leadership position in tomorrow’s global economy.” **What else happened this week?****Gov. Holcomb**[s](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/3e77136fed0b7faec3d6b838967d376c/40313)[hared an update](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/4811fa439f9db118c3d6b838967d376c/40313) on the My Healthy Baby program.****
* To stay up-to-date, follow **Gov. Holcomb** on [Facebook](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/a59aff99e56cb6e8c3d6b838967d376c/40313) or [Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/21980b57115f8058c3d6b838967d376c/40313).
