# 💬 _Hoosier Republicans Standing with Israel_
---
**[Governor Eric Holcomb -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/c9a0f52bb6c7a24ec3d6b838967d376c/40313) **"Reports this morning of the brutally directed Hamas land, air, and sea invasion into Israel brings the cruel reminder that terrorism seeks war not peace. The over 2,200 rockets launched into civilian neighborhoods, the long list of civilians killed and injured, the hostages taken are all tear jerking, especially knowing the war Hamas planned and sought, is the war they will get..." **[Lt. Governor Suzanne Crouch -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/140f2e4886d47168c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "Having visited Israel just last year, I am deeply saddened by the attacks that have taken place over the course of the day. My heart goes out to the Israeli people and the families of those who have already lost their lives to these senseless terrorist attacks. I pray for a speedy resolution and that Israel can once again experience peace." **[Senator Todd Young -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/cb46750ee792abbbc3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "I have strongly opposed the Administration’s decision to transfer $6 billion to the Iranian regime, which supports and funds Hamas, and I am pleased to see growing bipartisan congressional support for freezing these funds..." **[Senator Mike Braun -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/b1914369a8ca6dcbc3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "Iran knew they had $6 billion coming their way, and that windfall freed up resources to plan & execute the heinous terrorist attack from Hamas against our greatest ally in the region, Israel. The U.S. should freeze these funds immediately & permanently..." **[Attorney General Todd Rokita -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/eb602bd6a7e12ba1c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "our office teamed up with a coalition of 27 AGs in a joint statement condemning the Hamas terrorist attacks on Israel." **[Congressman Rudy Yakym -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/19f82bf2c1feabaac3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "Hamas’ barbaric terrorist attacks on Israel have shocked the conscience of the civilized world. Israel has an unequivocal right to defend itself and her citizens. America will always stand with Israel." **[Congressman Jim Banks -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/432aba4b709f7509c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "We must do everything in our power to help Israel. One of my amendments to the FY24 NDAA ensures Israel has the precision-guided munitions needed to prevail in a fight with Iran and its terrorist proxies. We need to get back to work and pass our strong House NDAA right away." **[Congressman Jim Baird -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/681e27dd1824af0cc3d6b838967d376c/40313) **"The attack by Hamas on the Israeli people is heinous and unacceptable. Now more than ever, we must stand by our Israeli allies in their struggle for peace and security. I stand with Israel now and always." [**Congresswoman Victoria Spartz** -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/3b365b1fb7efd847c3d6b838967d376c/40313) "Acts of terror committed against Israeli civilians this weekend cannot be tolerated by the international community. I urge our allies in the Middle East to stand with the people of Israel and not allow Teheran and Moscow to destabilize the Middle East using Hamas terrorists as a tool, and destroy the lives of millions. The United States will stand with the people of Israel in their fight to defend themselves and their nation." **[Congressman Greg Pence -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/add1574588aea04dc3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "Today, just 26 days after the Biden admin agreed to send $6 billion dollars to Iran, Israel, our strongest ally in the Middle-East, is under an unprecedented terrorist attack by Iran-backed Hamas. I stand with Israel, condemn these attacks, & I am praying for all those affected." **[Congressman Larry Bucshon -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/d3480f2b73dc6a40c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** "I stand with the people of Israel, a key ally and friend to the United States. We must condemn this ruthless terror by Hamas and fully support Israel’s right to defend itself." **[Congresswoman Erin Houchin -](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/bb7c439660707713c3d6b838967d376c/40313) **"I condemn, in the strongest possible terms, the unjustified and disgusting attacks by Hamas on our friend and ally Israel. Today, and everyday, I stand with the people of Israel as they defend their homeland from the scourge of terrorism."
---

October 14: [Decatur County Republican Party Lincoln Day Dinner](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/768c528ba8c61801c3d6b838967d376c/40313) October 16: ['23 Fall Election Red Rally](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/b5a8ffe113d0872cc3d6b838967d376c/40313) October 21: [2023 Lake County Republican Party Trap Shoot Fundraiser](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/611e046940b83b42c3d6b838967d376c/40313) October 21: [Owen County Reagan Day Chili Cook-Off](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/cd68a57192fcccadc3d6b838967d376c/40313) October 24: [Wabash County Lincoln Day Dinner](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/8b0587cb7d964609c3d6b838967d376c/40313) October 28: [Adams County Republican Party Benjamin Harrison Breakfast](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/b7959e9ee7ae2122c3d6b838967d376c/40313) October 30: [Orange County Republican Fall Dinner](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b0e2ade493c389e93947229f28c3afba/7bbe735ef03824e8c3d6b838967d376c/40313) _Events past these dates are available on our website and will be added to the newsletter as we approach them._

subject: Katie’s work to ease the burden of medical debt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Medical debt shouldn’t cause Americans a lifetime of financial harm.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=31333%2E3422442%2EXpR5RU)
Derek,
Did you know that roughly one in five Americans owe medical debt?
This debt primarily comes from hospital visits—and it _disproportionately_ impacts low-income Americans and people of color.
**Like any type of other debt, carrying this burden can have _significant ramifications_ when it comes to adversely affecting credit scores, which in turn can prevent someone from acquiring a loan, mortgage, or even an apartment.**
Earlier last month, the Biden Administration announced that it was taking the first steps toward removing this burden from people’s credit scores, which could significantly improve ratings for millions.
This announcement comes as Katie has worked tirelessly in Congress to champion legislation that would ease the burden of medical debt so many face. And once elected to the U.S. Senate, she will continue to work to push to ensure that medical debt won’t cause a lifetime of financial harm and to create a more just and equitable healthcare system.
**[If you agree, can you add your name to our petition today to show your support to ease the burden of medical debt?](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-medical-debt/?source=EMAM13_1_CTA_20231013_V1_F&akid=31333%2E3422442%2EXpR5RU)**

Eligible Hoosier voters can vote early in 2023 elections before Election Day on Tuesday, November 7th. Early voting locations and hours vary by county. To check when your county has early voting, go to your voter portal at [indianavoters.in.gov. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71527750/432393552/2018321534?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhY2YwYzY2Yi1mNTY5LWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vGkPXMfj8VefOIkeRXGA5BvwotBTU8ifV3o3rhFySp4=&emci=75517d29-f169-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=acf0c66b-f569-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) Take advantage of early voting to cast your ballot for amazing Democratic candidates across the state!

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Israel and Palestine
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
I'm writing today to share a few thoughts on the ongoing situation in Israel and Palestine. I hope you'll take a few minutes to read the note below, and to pray for peace in the entire region.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=615%2E791427%2ESeYnsC)

Friends -
I'm writing today to share a few thoughts on the ongoing situation in Israel and Palestine. I hope you'll take a few minutes to read the note below, and to pray for peace in the entire region.
As someone who has experienced the trauma of war, displacement, and living in a refugee camp firsthand, my heart is broken for thousands of people killed and many more displaced in the ongoing violence.
To be clear I condemn the horrific acts against children, women, the elderly, and the unarmed people who were being slaughtered and taken hostage in Israel.
Just as we honor the humanity of the hundreds of innocent Israeli civilians and 27 Americans who have been killed, we must honor the humanity of the innocent Palestinian civilians who have been killed and whose lives are being upended by the right-wing Israeli government.
Gaza’s population of over 2 million people is mostly children, who live under blockade in what Israel’s own former intelligence chief has called an open-air prison.
The overwhelming majority live in poverty. Many suffer lifelong psychological and physical trauma.
Palestinian residents of the West Bank have scarcely better lives than Gazans — with the routine destruction of their ancestral homes, destruction of their crops, and violent attacks by Israeli settlers.
According to Amnesty International, Human Rights watch, the UN, and Israeli human rights group B’Tselem, these policies meet the definition of apartheid. We know occupation and systematic apartheid are a violation of international law and it must end.
Palestinians have few recourses for justice and accountability. Attacks by the IDF and settlers against Palestinians are regularly met with impunity. Efforts to seek justice in international courts are stonewalled by the Israeli government, with U.S. support.
As the world is condemning Hamas’s attacks, we must also oppose an Israeli military response that has already taken the lives of untold numbers of Palestinians.
In recent days the Israeli Defense Minister said they are battling ‘human animals'. The military has cut off all electricity, food, and fuel to civilians, and last night ordered an immediate evacuation of over 1 million people in northern Gaza.
Let me be perfectly clear: The mass expulsion of over 1 million people in a day is ethnic cleansing.
We have to stop ignoring the thousands of Palestinian lives lost and millions at stake and use all diplomatic tools possible to stop this.
Many Palestinians are already wounded, displaced, and/or caring for a sick or injured relative, child, or senior.
With communications and electricity shut down by Israel, the order cannot be communicated. With roads bombed and cars out of fuel, fleeing becomes impossible for many.
Plus, with no announcement of a pause in hostilities to allow for safe civilian evacuation, people are afraid to leave and risk bombardment.
The mass expulsion of over a million civilians is a grave violation of international law, and not justified under any circumstances.
This collective punishment is a war crime, and the U.S. should oppose any violations of international law if we truly support a rules-based international order.
We must learn from the mistakes of our own war on terror — that military action alone rarely addresses the root causes. That peace and justice will not come from the barrel of a gun, and that targeting an entire civilian population will only sow more discord and perpetuate the cycle of violence.
The solution to this horror, as ever, is a negotiated peace — with Israelis and Palestinians enjoying equal rights and security guarantees.
I urge the United States at long last to use its diplomatic might to push for peace.
Our common humanity demands it.
Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

**** Serving in Congress and representing Pennsylvania’s Fourth district is the honor of my life. That my neighbors have entrusted me to do this job is an enormous privilege and a solemn responsibility – one that I do not take lightly.

**Our team asked you to share the most pressing issues on your mind right now – here is what we learned:** The top two issues you wanted Congress to work on were __gun violence prevention__ and __taking on climate change__. At the same time, you wanted to see House Democrats fight to protect reproductive rights, voting rights, and support democracy in all corners of the globe. **Peter, who we elect determines how we address issues — or whether we address them at all.** We’ve seen the current GOP majority – with a reckless, vocal far-right minority calling the shots – lead us to a Speaker-less House, jeopardizing our ability to do the work we were sent here to do.

Here’s what our Secretary of State had to say: “Ohio is a classic test market state... People know that, ‘Hey, if my product sells in Ohio, then I can sell it to other places.’ The same logic applies politically.” – Secretary of State Frank LaRose in Politico, 10/11/2023 Ohio is the GOP’s springboard on abortion restrictions. We have to prove to Republicans in our state and throughout the entire country that we refuse to let them silence our voices and use us as a test case for the anti-abortion movement. **= Thank you, Liz Walters | A reproductive rights initiative is on the Ohio ballot this November. clean_body: This is one of our favorites! | | Friend, we love scary stories! This is one of our favorites: Once upon a time, there was a young voter making their way to the polls on Election Day. They were so excited to cast their vote and make a difference in the race. But as they got to the front of the line to vote, they made a terrible discovery: They were at the wrong polling place! And even worse,they weren’t registered to vote at all! Because that one person couldn’t cast their vote, the candidate they were planning to vote for lost the election. Pretty scary stuff, right? We don’t want the same thing to happen to you. There’s nothing scarier than realizing at the polls that you aren’t registered to vote. And with 2024 right around the corner, there’s no better time than right now to make sure your voting plan is rock solid. Over 70 million Americans ages 18-35 are eligible to vote, more than any other age group. | | There is no doubt that the entire world feels heavy right now. The heart-wrenching situation in Israel is tough to watch—but we can’t look away—it’s time to look this evil in the face. The Jewish people need us now more than ever, and I am committed to giving them the tools and resources to be victorious against the [Hamas](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1d3d3c976566484fb8b87d0112d1905c&_e=mSgchJuUJ-VFULnVWx23yBmRrr9z3-U8lRL2TVcCXcTKu7xssxkaLPiBWK8S-BqZcGt3IU4LUKicB_i4E75GRYzYZim6Pspw3CwTJWujztTnwr6cPS4DFa8QoHI8BVEssYpWusO3TtKfjl4eefcRqzQterXr_XDFNeFROq18CNsZTYYubWD9HpQ2gZFk2PIhfYZkubiFnWuPDszieuwSMBoDMaa0YDeEUFK3ahhP2Ku0G6uf5vfS2o1XZS4rDyKdblt-HsJL1kKe3sKoYpNwLq88JBvcd67OhCjBLEfH3i1jQr2ZEqCaySDnAKlWHRvx9x60yj7mHxNTsflz2d48ug%3D%3D) terrorist thugs and [any other threat](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1d3d3c976566484fb8b87d0112d1905c&_e=mSgchJuUJ-VFULnVWx23yPKETyqSN0QQColhBxHa7eujUA8hnlHIQR3WJnmXzNG-mP92PuhY6cC3jJTuFJKnnSrYVR4eWJA3zXeSSdiATjMWDQTsF9c_i6EGdcs6p-CcoK1BzMbJA6Z7j5abt8Hsw7t6nQZ6j_8FuUh1Srm5IOmKSvciq_KWSoUa1nGizElUURHjcSEw3zsnfa5-mKNjtltWc-ejrNFrxga6S8MZ7ViuXh24NNqAgDRUqYcydD8zRLlAOpmUHg6cZdUX51ORnK5QrzkCCvNCNLTqsurljkLGta71WtBR_n6e7Ui3GSwBb_rMGw4PEiW5J6tsfzux3w%3D%3D). Mark my words: If [Iran](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1d3d3c976566484fb8b87d0112d1905c&_e=mSgchJuUJ-VFULnVWx23yA5KTv_UV0XpWHEiO0qClkUDsvSXm-skBxmFqw8wcE35Zg2UxjcaElguYfb5MK18SHhHsUGfSIJ37AbyYCGTbbfl9vTQgqjkYwg2MPpODYTAeycq12LbDZPvUcTuaz0BGnhmwqbYZA2XKndOexB9fpwHcr5aVpYw8Mb9m9uCZAV35KCR8094_LWb7P_B3RxEFco3kxTZJGtaOcqM-DnSxizrZ_Sr4or5CCD9e0l_skS6Iv88pTzviEG18IvI_XtEdVHzaSSZX_VDhtLLgX6r48k%3D) has their hands in this mess like the puppet master we know they are, they too need to answer for this savagery. The U.S. can’t continue to bankroll the vicious atrocities we’re seeing play out right now. We have tiptoed around Iran for too long, and our concessions have done nothing to curb their aggression. This is the last dadgum straw. I’m standing shoulder-to-shoulder with 100+ of my colleagues to stop the release of [$6 billion in frozen funds](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1d3d3c976566484fb8b87d0112d1905c&_e=mSgchJuUJ-VFULnVWx23yBmRrr9z3-U8lRL2TVcCXcQiP5alLopaBa1n_jiFvZeMxodyUuKvUUIoqnpDKYQm4qL__U5aeHmkQENwYl9jKttFuU71sU8uRKgAEAIBxQkdH3K0xZu54F2y8qrPD3oY88QbsofcSMPY1kQITcDCcBW6zFC3UhmNnkdqL8fiUHbK2no-1JJFFOHuvHVX829ylN0bOQgSgFDnhcWeGJpZ_Go4PGb8mI2u69zNWlUHfrIqrZoITLJQVGTx_XhiBnyeznp36h5jd-xfM1Qm8iLF10sK0J5Dd8q4w03AemD_lswvhLs1aJjcmBC5H2cir3r7KA%3D%3D) that the Biden administration recently made available to Iran. There is no doubt that this money would be used to fill in the gaps for Iran as they sponsor terror attacks on Israel—and we can’t allow that to happen. It is crucial that we remain a supportive and united front for our allies in the Middle East, and this is exactly what’s happening on Capitol Hill right now. Despite the [lukewarm reaction](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1d3d3c976566484fb8b87d0112d1905c&_e=mSgchJuUJ-VFULnVWx23yDf7gIURRxRU1aracQEDh8yndN_cxCSZoy1IJwXoA9ot2GtaBJvEuHGWQXyCqy75oeeA2EXcFKSA9guMNkbwrhEcRv46T-wGW9b5MzRvDEeAphfPvlpOqz-HRBc7RuMVnXMj5duXsBYMdmdTk_T22imCjPhXGmbVXTZMnfkqC5kbd3CAfBqcYEly5Odjhi4y-ZDDWntXMp-ccMpXWEVA6Y65ghZwuEcXhmLlRsB_-OkExO0IRbFp9KicwzLUK0upKWBThJ1Pb9AQpHaQfVtUoc8%3D) from some folks on the other side of the aisle, Republicans are more serious than ever about coming together to rally around our Israeli friends. We will continue to defend them until this thing is through, no matter how long it takes. Old Testament justice is coming for Hamas—and it’s closing in faster than a bat out of hell.

Part of the group traveled to Jordan to leave in the next few days and others will fly out of Tel Aviv to an airport where a U.S. carrier can bring them back. My staff and I are working to ensure my constituents that are in Israel are able to safely evacuate. Unfortunately, for security and privacy reasons, my office can’t release further details. I know I speak for all of us when I say we are praying for their safe return home while also mourning the 1,000+ Jewish lives lost in this horrific conflict. I unequivocally stand with the Jewish people, and my heart goes out to the community we have right here in Knoxville. The Knoxville Jewish Alliance held a [prayer rally](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1d3d3c976566484fb8b87d0112d1905c&_e=mSgchJuUJ-VFULnVWx23yKLLPLJtXN9cE-YIonSPebcVvbCQahZ_Ju8HZVaF56jlLGBVKPwVcY11vAM_Jbw3PeiJYoQkAUNtpJ3mRGlJbNETelayO1ShbiWSzC9B4UXFL3ItCmymPAXJRICChpiABhCUQ26l1B_3T3jW1_814gpXolnHOWaeB0jMWBoaFprdlbNlm6bw7MP9TRUX7XNiSEDiKNJKVQNHGB65Mjz2y74mBmSJLvXpYDXbSkdsa3EQL5bz6NoYJlS7DhMpQUa_nCyTnVPujIBq8PmesAieIVD-8FgpQEcQHkbNKek-wI8H) this week for people to join together and bond over scripture and songs. The group is also gathering donations such as sleeping bags, flashlights, and clothes to send to Israel. Letters for soldiers are another great way to show support for our friends in Israel and reiterate that we stand in solidarity with them.

body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f_KPNvcj/NHJodVd2a1l1a3FPU0t0NXg0S2hVamhCRitNWmFOdE1QRlgzelg0WVoyQU0zeFFNSml2OGFaWlBBYzV1T0I5RGNTaGYrUW5jM3QyenAwSG1ydXJvRytRV3o5eDNRNjlKZ09zaGwvMU55dFk9S0/b0tHU1JOczAraE5ZWEh2S0hSQm1ia041U3pxZktXN3RIOGwvN1FvOEVIUlBOQktSMjRhc3hpSENLSVh4VjlHcHdYRFBhMmVqUHc4UGlaWHZUNFludDBhRDVCWGtnZ25YS0 ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDv92ete/NHJodVd2a1l1a3FPU0t0NXg0S2hVamhCRitNWmFOdE1QRlgzelg0WVoyQU0zeFFNSml2OGFaWlBBYzV1T0I5RGNTaGYrUW5jM3QyenAwSG1ydXJvRytRV3o5eDNRNjlKZ09zaGwvMU55dFk9S0/b0tHU1JOczAraE5ZWEh2S0hSQm1ia041U3pxZktXN3RIOGwvN1FvOEVIUlBOQktSMjRhc3hpSENLSVh4VjlHcHdYRFBhMmVqUHc4UGlaWHZUNFludDBhRDVCWGtnZ25YS0

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

**We founded Courier Newsroom as a direct response to this toxic dynamic, Peter.** We believe right-wing media can and should be held accountable for the harm they are doing to our democracy and we’re asking for your help to fight back.

The impact stokes violence, division, and a deep distrust in journalism and our public institutions.
To fight back, Courier’s innovative model uses quality, local journalism to stop the spread of lies at their online sources.
Our newsroom teams in nine battleground states (and growing!) correct the record in real time while providing invaluable local news coverage to communities that are vulnerable to right-wing manipulation.
But in order to keep the lights on in our newsrooms, we need your generous support.

Peter,

Last week, EMILYs List celebrated an incredible full circle moment when our former President Laphonza Butler was appointed to the U.S. Senate by California Gov. Gavin Newsom, and sworn in on the Senate floor by Vice President Kamala Harris.

EMILYs List was founded to break down barriers for women running for public office, a simple mission at a time when actually making it happen was anything but. We had to upend the status quo to prove that women could in fact run, win, and change the world. And for nearly 40 years, EMILYs List has done just that — working against the odds to change the face of power, recruiting candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences, and empowering them with the tools and resources to build winning campaigns.

We know how important this cycle will be in protecting our rights, our democracy, and our communities. The work of finding our next president is already underway, but we also know our work to elect more women can't wait. **That's why I'm deeply honored to announce that I have been asked to serve as the interim president of EMILYs List.**

Believe it or not, my career in politics began at EMILYs List years ago, when I started here as a political researcher. I went on to work with other campaigns and committees, but EMILYs List has remained at the center of my political universe for all these years. During the 2022 cycle, I came back to head our Campaigns team.

From the beginning, EMILYs List's success has been driven by the strength of our community. By each and every one of you — whether you've been with us from the start or are newer to the EMILYs List family. Your trust and investment have fueled our success, and we know our work cannot stop for a moment given the stakes of this year and next.

**With that urgency in mind, I'm asking for your input, Peter. Will you take a moment to answer some questions about your priorities for this election cycle?**

North Carolina is a key battleground state for the 2024 elections. **That also means it’s a battleground state for the GOP’s attacks on voting rights.** So far this year, North Carolina’s GOP supermajority is clearing the way for _partisan gerrymandering, discriminatory voter ID laws, cuts to early voting, and reducing ballot access by eliminating mail-in ballots._

subject: Did you see our message?

body:
| Hey there — Did you see our message? Sharice wants to know what issues are impacting supporters like you the most as we mount our response to the latest slew of NRCC-backed attacks against her record.

Will you take our quick fall priorities survey before our midnight deadline to let us know what’s on your mind in 2024’s elections?

**_[https://act.shariceforcongress.com/a/fall-priorities-survey](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71536402/432424065/-853054107?source=EM_NBI_SD_20231013_SV_fall_1.2_0_1MO_cm_NA_NA_fallpriorities&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZGM3NjEyOC0wZjZhLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e00Ie4tKgMH6_peXqapfRMYdgxPEKCxj4o7s8dkd-LM=&emci=32a16521-0f6a-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=2dc76128-0f6a-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=22117458)_**

Thanks,
Mohona
* * *
_**Begin Forwarded Message:**_

Look, if we’ve seen anything over the past few weeks with the shutdown drama and speakership fight, it’s that House GOP leadership has not been focused on working families. Instead too many leaders are in Congress to grandstand and get featured on cable news.

**That’s not why Sharice is in Congress. Instead, she is determined to continue to deliver results for Kansan families every day—working across the aisle to get it done.**

I don’t know about you, friend, but I’m tired of dysfunction in Washington. From narrowly averting a government shutdown in the eleventh hour to voting to oust House Speaker Kevin McCarthy — the first two weeks of October in Congress have been full of chaos and disarray. The American people are waiting on their elected officials in Washington to work together, not fight amongst themselves and stall our progress. I came to Congress to cut through the noise and political games to deliver real, meaningful legislation that working families in Central and Southern Illinois and across the country have been asking for, and I'm committed to seeing that through. clean_body: | I don’t know about you, friend, but I’m tired of dysfunction in Washington. From narrowly averting a government shutdown in the eleventh hour to voting to oust House Speaker Kevin McCarthy — the first two weeks of October in Congress have been full of chaos and disarray. The American people are waiting on their elected officials in Washington to work together, not fight amongst themselves and stall our progress. I came to Congress to cut through the noise and political games to deliver real, meaningful legislation that working families in Central and Southern Illinois and across the country have been asking for, and I'm committed to seeing that through. No matter how much chaos erupts in Congress, I will always put the American people first and will fight to overcome the partisan games and antics. But the harsh reality is I’m up for reelection next year and already have two GOP opponents in the race hoping to take my seat, flip IL-13, and roll back our progress. Ahead of 2024, we’ll need all hands on deck to stay competitive against Republicans bankrolled by ultra-wealthy donors, and I know we can do it one dollar donor at a time. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Thank you for standing with me in this fight. — Nikki Nikki for Congress PO Box 5171 Springfield, IL 62705 United States ** | mailto:info@nikkiforcongress.com | Paid for by Nikki Budzinski for Congress

name: Ritchie Torres
subject: Why I do what I do.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Torres For Congress PO Box 580303, Bronx, NY 10458
body:
My personal struggle with mental health drives the work that I do in Congress every day

|
---
This past Tuesday was World Mental Health Day, a reminder to us all that **mental health care is a necessity, not a luxury.**

I’ve always been open about my personal struggle with mental health and my experience receiving mental health care – I would not be alive, _let alone in Congress_ , without it.

But right now, we live in a country where countless Americans face deeply rooted barriers and stigma to accessing mental health care.

My personal struggle with mental health drives the work that I do in Congress every day. I vow to _always_ fight for expanded access to affordable mental health care.

**[That’s why I’m asking if you’ll make a donation to the National Alliance on Mental Illness. Their work is critical to saving lives, and I can’t bust the stigma surrounding mental health alone. »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71537005/432426318/1908495094?refcode=RTFC_20231013_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZmJjYmJlNi0xMTZhLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uuPvCN7xxaq1-pBZ-oq06BTKzr-UAvB1ak0aylU1-V4=&emci=0909f95f-de69-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=afbcbbe6-116a-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=34594689)** | [CLICK HERE TO MAKE A DONATION »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71537006/432426319/1908495094?refcode=RTFC_20231013_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZmJjYmJlNi0xMTZhLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uuPvCN7xxaq1-pBZ-oq06BTKzr-UAvB1ak0aylU1-V4=&emci=0909f95f-de69-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&emdi=afbcbbe6-116a-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&ceid=34594689)

Thank you, Peter!

_Ritchie_
| | Paid for by Torres For Congress PO Box 580303, Bronx, NY 10458
www.torres.nyc

Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. He fought tirelessly for the working families of The Bronx, and now, he's fighting for those families and for progressive values in Congress. We are also amplifying the efforts of organizations that are working with civilian populations in Israel and Gaza, particularly those seeking to assist families and children. Peter - Here's a comprehensive analysis and summary of the key insights, patterns, and significant takeaways derived from this week's polling data.
The last week has seen notable shifts in public opinion.
**National** FOX News, October 12, 2023
[](https://democraticpolling.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=586e186cabca76a710f21bdf1&id=c79f4ff233&e=30112466a7)
To begin with, according to the recent poll conducted by Fox News - and it's noteworthy to emphasize that this is indeed Fox News - Biden is currently leading with 49% of the respondents' support, compared to the 48% backing his opponent.
However, it's crucial to take into consideration that this slim lead is within the poll's margin of error.
**Wisconsin** Emerson, October 12, 2023
[](https://democraticpolling.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=586e186cabca76a710f21bdf1&id=fe8404c09f&e=30112466a7)
Shifting our focus to the pivotal swing states, in Wisconsin the polling data reveals a close contest.
Biden is currently behind by a narrow margin of 2%.
Given the importance of Wisconsin in the electoral landscape, this close race underscores the significance of every vote and the potential for the outcome to come down to just a handful of votes.
**Pennsylvania** Emerson, October 11, 2023
[](https://democraticpolling.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=586e186cabca76a710f21bdf1&id=5d9f61ead6&e=30112466a7)
The most recent updates emerging from Pennsylvania present a challenging scenario. Biden is currently lagging behind in the polls by a margin of 9%.
The data suggests that there's a need for a reevaluation of strategies and efforts to understand the underlying factors influencing this notable gap in voter support
On a more positive note, the polling data from Nevada paints a slightly brighter picture. Biden is currently leading, albeit by a slender margin of just 1%.
**Nevada** CNN, October 10, 2023
[](https://democraticpolling.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=586e186cabca76a710f21bdf1&id=e1ceec0d9d&e=30112466a7)
We are profoundly grateful for every ounce of effort you've poured in. Truly, words fall short in expressing our appreciation.
Imagine the sheer elation, the immense joy of achieving success once again. Envision the new dawn of hope such a victory in 2024 symbolizes, and the beacon of a brighter future it promises.
**Will you vote for Joe Biden?**
| [Yes](https://democraticpolling.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=586e186cabca76a710f21bdf1&id=3562a9fb38&e=30112466a7)

| [No](https://democraticpolling.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=586e186cabca76a710f21bdf1&id=a84d2188dc&e=30112466a7)

The thought of a Trump’s triumph in 2024 is deeply unsettling. The looming potential of such an outcome underscores a desperate plea for reflection, foresight, and a profound connection to the heartbeats of every citizen.
Your unwavering commitment is essential, and we cannot thank you enough. With advocates like you, we hope to steer the course in a different direction.
Your support means everything. Thank you.
-Democratic Polling

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71538084/432430253/1610638071?refcode=em20231013pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=524b9f8d-166a-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjRiOWY4ZC0xNjZhLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8UJKVuZfA7D7BhjF_mUurodO6WH_NJVE5fXnSK13b3o=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**My opponent, Lauren Boebert, wants you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is Boebert pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Boebert’s views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing her seat in Congress last year, Lauren Boebert might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But she’s only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024.**
[**Please, if you’re able to, will you consider chipping in to my campaign today to help me finally defeat Lauren Boebert in 2024? Our race was the closest in the country, but I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to hold Boebert accountable and win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/71538085/432430254/1610638071?refcode=em20231013pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=524b9f8d-166a-ee11-9937-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjRiOWY4ZC0xNjZhLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8UJKVuZfA7D7BhjF_mUurodO6WH_NJVE5fXnSK13b3o=)

| Whether it’s Trump, big corporations, or special interests — Adam stands up for what’s right.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=4237%2E5257348%2E0G6Li3)
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2023_abs_em.EYisyV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_AC90_20231013_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=4237%2E5257348%2E0G6Li3)
Hello Derek, it's me, Jamie Lee Curtis.
As a lifelong Californian, I’ve had the great privilege of being represented by some incredible United States Senators.
And one common quality that each of them has had — one I can very much say that my friend Adam Schiff shares — is this: **They know they work for us, not the other way around.**
Unfortunately, in a Senate populated by the likes of Mitch McConnell, Ted Cruz, and Lindsey Graham, that’s not a universally held quality.
But it is with Adam.
**We deserve leaders who won’t shrink from the big fights.** For equality. For opportunity. For the common good. For democracy.
As MAGA Republicans attack transgender children, LGBTQ equality, abortion rights, and ban books, I’m grateful we have a leader like Adam who will always stand up to the people abusing their power.
_No matter the threats, no matter the cost._
Whether it’s Trump, big corporations, or special interests — Adam stands up for what’s right.
But the truth is that many of the most important fights we face as a country will be waged in the United States Senate. And California needs to elect a Senator we can send there to get things done.
That’s why I’m supporting Adam in this race, and I hope you will too.

# Capitol Report
October 13, 2023
---
|
---
| **Sen. Steven Roberts welcomes state auditor investigation into STL city jail**
The Missouri state auditor has announced plans to investigate the city jail in St. Louis over several allegations of mismanagement, inhumane treatment, and interference with the Detention Facilities Oversight Board (DFOB). The news of the auditor’s investigation comes after Senator Steven Roberts, D-St. Louis received a letter from the civilian board outlining several examples of the city obstructing their efforts to seek transparency.

“DFOB’s letter to the state auditor outlines several examples of obstruction and an overall lack of transparency from the mayor’s administration over the city’s handling of numerous allegations of inhumane treatment by detainees, family members, and attorneys,” Roberts said. “Perhaps most concerning is the allegation that administrators told DFOB members that they do not have the authority to investigate operations in the City Jail, despite the law stating that they do.”

Three incarcerated people have died within six weeks at the city jail.
---
|
---
| **Bailey claims vacated case still in effect, can't be appealed**
Republican Attorney General Andrew Bailey argued in an Oct. 10 legal filing that even though the Missouri Supreme Court vacated a trial judge’s decision striking down two state emergency management regulations, the invalidated decision somehow remains in effect and now can’t be appealed since the original plaintiffs have voluntarily dismissed the case. As of Oct. 12, the other parties in the case hadn’t yet responded to Bailey’s audacious claim.

Several opponents to state and local restrictions during the COVID-19 pandemic had challenged the Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services regulations and won a favorable ruling from Cole County Circuit Judge Dan Green in November 2021. Although the department wanted to appeal, their attorney – then-Attorney General Eric Schmitt – refused and instead used the case to try to browbeat local governments and school districts into ending all disease mitigation efforts, including those based on other legal authority not challenged in the case. That prompted a long legal battle as Jackson and St. Louis counties sought to intervene for the purpose of appealing Green’s ruling.

The Missouri Supreme Court ultimately sided with the counties and vacated Green’s decision in August. With the case back in Green’s court, the original plaintiffs filed a motion on Oct. 6 to the voluntarily dismiss it, saying that even though the high court had erased their victory, they no longer wished to pursue the matter.

In an unexpected twist, however, Bailey, who replaced Schmitt in January and is now representing the department, filed a motion claiming that even though the Supreme Court wiped out Green’s decision, his ruling that the disputed regulations are unconstitutional nonetheless stands and can’t be appealed due to the subsequent dismissal by the plaintiffs.

“The Supreme Court’s opinion does not undo the effects of the (trial) court’s original judgment, revive regulations judicially declared as unconstitutional and return Missouri to a pandemic-era state,” Bailey’s filing says. “The merits of this court’s judgment still stand. The counties should operate accordingly.”

Bailey’s assertion that Green’s ruling on the merits somehow remains in effect and is not appealable does not square with the Supreme Court’s Sept. 1 order informing Green that his original decision is “reversed, annulled and for naught held and esteemed and that the said St. Louis County and Jackson Counties be restored to all things which they have lost by reason of said judgment.” Those things include any legal authority lost by Green’s invalidation of the rules and the right to challenge a decision adverse to their interests.

Bailey’s latest maneuvering likely means there will be more months of legal wrangling in the case,_Shannon Robinson, et al., v. Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services, et al._

| **Net revenue collections down 2.9 percent so far in FY 2024**
Net state general revenue collections for the first quarter of the 2024 fiscal year decreased 2.9 percent compared to the same period in FY 2023, going from $3.24 billion last year to $3.14 billion this year. Collections had been down 2 percent through the first two months of FY 2024.

Net general revenue collections in September 2023 decreased 4.2 percent compared to September 2022, going from $1.26 billion last year to $1.21 billion this year. Even though sales taxes collections increased 15.4 percent compared to last September, declines of nearly 9 percent in both individual and corporate income taxes drove the drop in overall revenue collections for the month.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=3de2d64b1d&e=a088917f89). Applicants may also call SBA’s Customer Service Center at (800) 659-2955 or email [disastercustomerservice@sba.gov](mailto:disastercustomerservice@sba.gov) for more information on SBA disaster assistance.

Steven Roberts welcomes state auditor investigation into STL city jail The Missouri state auditor has announced plans to investigate the city jail in St. Louis over several allegations of mismanagement, inhumane treatment, and interference with the Detention Facilities Oversight Board (DFOB). The news of the auditor’s investigation comes after Senator Steven Roberts, D-St. Louis received a letter from the civilian board outlining several examples of the city obstructing their efforts to seek transparency. “DFOB’s letter to the state auditor outlines several examples of obstruction and an overall lack of transparency from the mayor’s administration over the city’s handling of numerous allegations of inhumane treatment by detainees, family members, and attorneys,” Roberts said. “Perhaps most concerning is the allegation that administrators told DFOB members that they do not have the authority to investigate operations in the City Jail, despite the law stating that they do.” Three incarcerated people have died within six weeks at the city jail. | | Bailey claims vacated case still in effect, can't be appealed Republican Attorney General Andrew Bailey argued in an Oct. 10 legal filing that even though the Missouri Supreme Court vacated a trial judge’s decision striking down two state emergency management regulations, the invalidated decision somehow remains in effect and now can’t be appealed since the original plaintiffs have voluntarily dismissed the case. As of Oct. 12, the other parties in the case hadn’t yet responded to Bailey’s audacious claim. Several opponents to state and local restrictions during the COVID-19 pandemic had challenged the Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services regulations and won a favorable ruling from Cole County Circuit Judge Dan Green in November 2021. Although the department wanted to appeal, their attorney – then-Attorney General Eric Schmitt – refused and instead used the case to try to browbeat local governments and school districts into ending all disease mitigation efforts, including those based on other legal authority not challenged in the case. That prompted a long legal battle as Jackson and St. Louis counties sought to intervene for the purpose of appealing Green’s ruling. The Missouri Supreme Court ultimately sided with the counties and vacated Green’s decision in August. With the case back in Green’s court, the original plaintiffs filed a motion on Oct. 6 to the voluntarily dismiss it, saying that even though the high court had erased their victory, they no longer wished to pursue the matter. In an unexpected twist, however, Bailey, who replaced Schmitt in January and is now representing the department, filed a motion claiming that even though the Supreme Court wiped out Green’s decision, his ruling that the disputed regulations are unconstitutional nonetheless stands and can’t be appealed due to the subsequent dismissal by the plaintiffs. “The Supreme Court’s opinion does not undo the effects of the (trial) court’s original judgment, revive regulations judicially declared as unconstitutional and return Missouri to a pandemic-era state,” Bailey’s filing says. “The merits of this court’s judgment still stand. The counties should operate accordingly.” Bailey’s assertion that Green’s ruling on the merits somehow remains in effect and is not appealable does not square with the Supreme Court’s Sept. 1 order informing Green that his original decision is “reversed, annulled and for naught held and esteemed and that the said St. Louis County and Jackson Counties be restored to all things which they have lost by reason of said judgment.” Those things include any legal authority lost by Green’s invalidation of the rules and the right to challenge a decision adverse to their interests. Bailey’s latest maneuvering likely means there will be more months of legal wrangling in the case,Shannon Robinson, et al., v. For example, when Biden took office, his administration immediately ended the border wall project. Ever since, even as the nation suffered a terrible border crisis, the Department of Defense has sat on 20,822 unused border wall panels. Adding insult to injury, storing the materials costs $160,000 every single month. It should be clear to you that our federal government is hopelessly broken. Holding your breath waiting for Congress to tackle the debt is useless. In fact, the more we wait for Washington to fix itself, the worse the problem gets. **[That’s why I’m urging you, right now, to sign the Convention of States petition for an Article V convention -– the only viable solution to federal overreach and reckless spending.](http://email.myamericanpatriot.org/c/eJxckb-O2zwQxJ-G6mSIuyfSLlR8X3RKECQprkiRhqDIPZk-_hFIKo7z9IEcIwjSsBgOduc3q8Pq3ettYPJ_BnB2tjAAhv8xgOXr98v2Aj8_1_b5I3bt8yV86vZfeMcA6m2lP9bHlAMF7fyuyrGxw9wfjTg1NHBxkoAnicfmPEiuOQoS8-tsTx3hDL1E5Nh3VkjOqXEDdIC84wgIx14cAMlIo82MHZd04uypCzcdKDuj46prdqkeUl4aP5xrXcs908RgMqkc4mY8bWXVC5WDSYHB5HW0Li4MpjllS7m9au_bqy6VWmA4bTWoQNZtgeH4QBK7WNKWDTEc_6omGq8e-A-X0WHVbokMxx2j69v9USYV5V2pKlOs2qs562hVpKsyab2pi34jVbb5QqaqWQW9qkyFolWZkjFbzvfIvzekWClWhmM0vg3hbVk-vEzLNwZCRe8sw_Ef8X5YHHXqbRVffrxv8mDXq_PeFSHZU7fslHs9vwIAAP__sIysyw)** Calling an Article V convention is about so much more than just balancing the Feds’ outrageous budget. It’s about bringing power back to the states and people and ending Washington’s runaway reign. body:
Biden Border Crisis UPDATE!

[INSIDE JW]

U.S. CAPITOL POLICE FEDERAL COURT FILING REVEALS OFFICIALS WERE AWARE
OF THE POTENTIAL FOR A SIGNIFICANT DISTURBANCE ON JANUARY 6

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30438&F=T&&hash=b33654357f12ffa3f3346f6260f9c4cb9faa057ba853598dc9cd74082c1110a6]

“Things are not always what they seem,” the ancient Greek
aristocrat Phaedrus said. “The first appearance deceives many; the
intelligence of a few perceives what has been carefully hidden.” So,
it goes with the events of January 6, 2021.

Judicial Watch just received the court-ordered declaration
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30428&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdXMtY2FwaXRvbC1wb2xpY2UtZGVjbGFyYXRpb24tamFtZXMtdy1qb3ljZS0wMDQwMS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=48268c79fb3ebf553b981bfa02ef3ab2fb0b9b8530a642d4293530034a35b709]
of James W. Joyce, senior counsel in the Office of the General Counsel
for the Capitol Police, in which he describes emails among senior
officials of the United States Capitol Police (USCP) in January 2021
that show warnings of possible January 6 protests that could lead to
serious disruptions at the U.S. Capitol.

The declaration comes in a lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30429&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanctc3Vlcy1jYXBpdG9sLXBvbGljZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=62af755cbf61efb73323b29f5d5fc4e968912d0ddef8b538bc88a963c396d541]
we brought
under the common law right of access to public records (_Judicial
Watch v. United States Capitol Police_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=22132&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdW5pdGVkLXN0YXRlcy1jYXBpdG9sLXBvbGljZS0xMjEtY3YtMDA0MDEvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=582629c5aae160dd38101494a9233a96c835839506250e767846cfeaef3f4b1d]
(No. 1:21-cv-00401)). The suit requests:

> Email communications between the U.S. Capitol Police Executive Team
> and the Capitol Police Board concerning the security of the Capitol
> on January 6, 2021. The timeframe of this request is from January 1,
> 2021 through January 10, 2021.
>
> Email communications of the Capitol Police Board with the Federal
> Bureau of Investigation, the U.S. Department of Justice, and the
> U.S. Department of Homeland Security concerning the security of the
> Capitol on January 6, 2021. The timeframe of this request is from
> January 1, 2021 through January 10, 2021.
>
> All video footage from within the Capitol between 12 pm and 9 pm on
> January 6, 2021.
After an August 15, 2023, hearing
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30430&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdXNjcC10cmFuc2NyaXB0LTAwNDAxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=32125e40dff75d8feb30ed6d94de796a313abe8bbb33e455f216c501636b1647],
in which U.S. District Judge Ana C. Reyes ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30431&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdXNjcC1vcmRlci0wMDQwMS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=2035ede39d8c0f7701b732ef195800975ba7bceb61e456757cec60254ec5438a]
the
Capitol Police to provide us more detailed descriptions of certain
emails that had been withheld, the U.S. Capitol Police filed a
seven-page “second declaration
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30432&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdXMtY2FwaXRvbC1wb2xpY2UtZGVjbGFyYXRpb24tamFtZXMtdy1qb3ljZS0wMDQwMS9dLOKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=1495da9b9ab84fbc215d9e1c7be83718aec92018a8a181ac668825ba93754e72
which describes email discussions of evacuations and relocations of
people from certain buildings, arrests, and other security matters.

The U.S. Capitol Police describe “situational security update”
emails at issue as follows:

> a. A January 3, 2021 email, with attachment, from the USCP Deputy
> Chief to a Board member and others at USCP and in Congress providing
> a detailed “special event assessment” of anticipated protest
> activity in advance of the January 6, 2021 Joint Session of
> Congress. The attached document is marked on each page “For
> Official Use Only/Law Enforcement Sensitive.”
>
> b. A January 5, 2021 email, with map attachment, from the USCP Chief
> to two Board members detailing a proposed “bike rack” security
> perimeter for January 6, 2021, and proposing further discussion.
>
> c. A January 5, 2021 email, with map attachment, from the USCP Chief
> to two Board members detailing a proposed security perimeter for
> January 6, 2021.
>
> d. A January 5, 2021 email, with social media post and map
> attachments, from the USCP Deputy Chief to a Board member and others
> at USCP and in Congress reporting “a significant uptick in new
> visitors” to a “historical website” containing information on
> Capitol system tunnels. The Deputy Chief describes proposed attempts
> by unauthorized individuals to block members of Congress from
> entering the Capitol building, through tunnels or otherwise.
>
> e. A January 5, 2021 email from the USCP Deputy Chief to a Board
> member and others at USCP and in Congress alerting them to an online
> website soliciting information on high-level government officials
> and their expected whereabouts on January 6, 2021, and linking to
> the website’s article entitled _Why the Second American Revolution
> Starts Jan 6_.
>
> f. A January 6, 2021 email from the USCP Chief to Board members and
> others at USCP and in Congress relaying that the President had
> completed a speech at the Ellipse and that a large group was
> preparing to approach the Capitol.
>
> g. A January 6, 2021 email thread between the USCP Chief, two Board
> members, and congressional staffers responding to questions on the
> status of evacuations and relocations of certain buildings on the
> Capitol Grounds on January 6, 2021, and relaying information on
> crowds gathering near the Washington Monument and on Capitol Grounds
> on January 6, 2021.
>
> h. A series of four January 6, 2021 emails from the USCP Deputy
> Chief to a Board member and others at the USCP and in Congress
> providing four updates throughout the course of January 6, 2021.
> These updates contain intelligence assessments, information on
> arrests, coordination with other law enforcement agencies, crowd
> estimates, scheduling of high-level government officials, threat and
> incident reports, medical responses, and officer deployment status.
>
> i. A January 7, 2021 email, with photo attachment, from the USCP
> Deputy Chief to Board members and others in Congress providing an
> update on the arrest and subsequent charging of an armed individual
> found in a “suspicious vehicle” on January 6, 2021.
The U.S. Capitol Police describe “updates on police personnel
issues” emails at issue as follows:

> a. A January 7, 2021 email from the USCP Chief to all Board
> members and others at the USCP and in Congress providing an update
> on the medical condition of a USCP officer following the events of
> January 6, 2021.
>
> b. A January 7, 2021 email from the USCP Chief to all Board members
> and others at USCP and in Congress providing an update on the
> medical condition of a USCP officer following the events of January
> 6, 2021.
>
> c. A January 7, 2021 email from the USCP Chief to all Board members
> and others at USCP and in Congress providing an update on the death
> of a USCP officer following the events of January 6, 2021.
>
> d. A January 8, 2021 email from the USCP Chief to a Board member and
> others at USCP and in Congress concerning the lowering of flags to
> half-staff in recognition of a USCP officer who died in the line of
> duty on January 6, 2021.
>
> e. A January 9, 2021 email from the USCP Acting Chief to all Board
> members providing an update on when autopsy results could be
> expected for a deceased USCP officer following the events of January
> 6, 2021.

Another email is described under the category of “updates about news
media reports:”

> A January 7, 2021 email, with attachment, from the USCP Chief to all
> Board members and others at USCP and in Congress providing an
> anticipated statement by the USCP on the events that transpired at
> the Capitol on January 6, 2021.
On September 29, 2023, the Capitol Police filed a motion to dismiss
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30433&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtY2FwaXRvbC1wb2xpY2UtbXRkLTAwNDAxLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=c76f4fc73ebaa8525827bdef1347ea2b919882785982725013b2fcc4276b6ecc]
our common law right of access lawsuit that asks for over 14,000 hours
of video footage, arguing that the USCP has a sovereign immunity
exemption from lawsuits asserting a common law right of access to
public information. The latest filing goes further than prior Pelosi
Congress secrecy arguments in this litigation by newly asserting that
even if a lawsuit were allowed to go forward, all January 6 videos and
emails would be exempt from disclosure as “security information.”

We also received the January 7, 2021, resignation letter
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30434&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtdXMtY2FwaXRvbC1wb2xpY2UtcmVzaWduYXRpb24tY2hpZWYtc3RldmVuLXN1bmQtMDA0MDEvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=7d0dad2c1933b43d656c71b4082f8934d965f8cbe07063fdf7071cefff2fea0c]
of Steven A. Sund, chief of the Capitol Police on January 6, who left
the position at the request
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30435&F=T&&hash=63c892464bef3b4886e97f21dc96afbfff388a4f8f1bed90ea81ebcf9b1be255]
of House Speaker Nancy Pelosi.

It is urgent that the January 6 videos and related U.S. Capitol Police
emails be released to the American public. I would hope the next House
speaker takes a different approach than Nancy Pelosi and Kevin
McCarthy and affirms the public’s lawful ‘right to know’ – and
stops working with the Biden Justice Department to hide this January 6
evidence.

Your Judicial Watch is extensively investigating the events of January
6.

Last month we received records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=65398&L=30173&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvamFudWFyeS02LXByb3Rlc3RvcnMtdGFyZ2V0ZWQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=aea6cd69ab6202353613d55e61ca57aa6dbaea0fa7f6a9fb55670a0e84ce80bf]
